key_insight: RS-MFBO combines sensitivity-based dimension reduction with multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization to cut expensive simulator calls while preserving strong optimization performance.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to optimize complex industrial process flowsheets when high-fidelity simulations are slow and design spaces are large.
method: Use Global Sensitivity Analysis to reduce the search space to the most influential variables.
Train a fidelity-augmented Gaussian process that links cheap approximations with expensive simulator outputs.
Apply a cost-aware acquisition rule with cooldown and promotion to decide which fidelity to sample next.
evidence_signal: The framework was tested on two industrial simulators—a plasmid DNA bioprocess and a green fuel synthesis plant—and reported fewer high-fidelity evaluations with competitive results versus single-fidelity baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the low-fidelity models and the GSA step, so poor surrogate correlation or missed important variables could weaken gains.
paper_title: Reduced-Space Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization of Process Simulation Models
